svg.text: Ground-floor corporate office - Stage II Knitting Apparel Ltd. / Unit-1 / Zara Fashion - Holding 329/2, Ward 15, Vogra, Bason, Gazipur
Interior design proposal - not for construction - all dimensions to be verified on site
Ceiling: existing steel deck and beams kept exposed and painted warm white (client instruction: beams stay).
Underside of deck 9'-6" (114 in) is a photo estimate - verify before ordering suspension lengths.
Pendant bottoms: offices 80 in, reception/boardroom 80-84 in, halo 80-82 in above finished floor.
Suspended linear LED 4000K, direct/indirect (offices, studio, CAD)
Exposed steel beam (kept, painted; layout PHOTO-EST)
VRF under-ceiling indoor unit (sizes by MEP engineer)
